_comment: Example operator policy for tools/autonomy-controller. Copy it OUTSIDE every checkout (for example /etc/ashlar/controller-policy.json, mode 0600) and point the controller at it with --policy or ASHLAR_CONTROLLER_POLICY. The loader refuses a policy that lives inside a checkout, so this file cannot be the active policy. Model ids: claude-sonnet-5 is recognised by the installed Claude Code CLI (2.1.263, probed 2026-10-11) and was accepted by the API in the live launches of 2026-10-11 and 2026-10-13. Codex (PR 5): gpt-6-astra was accepted by codex-cli 0.162.0-alpha.17.2 on a ChatGPT login (probed 2026-10-12, and in the live run of 2026-10-13); the earlier candidate sol was refused with HTTP 400 "not supported when using Codex with a ChatGPT account". Cursor (PR 5): composer-2.5 was accepted by cursor-agent 2026.10.01-e373342 in the live run of 2026-10-13; the earlier example id composer-standard was reported not offered by the CLI (the model listing was not captured). Both stay disabled until the operator enables them.
